cards.title: MOQ-Playa
cards.desc: A MOQ browser player built on WebCodecs with low-latency A/V sync, adaptive jitter buffering, and ABR track switching. Supports LOC and CMSF packaging on draft-14, 16 and 18 relays.

cards.title: MOQtail player
cards.desc: Draft 16-compliant MOQ Transport (MOQT) protocol libraries for publisher, subscriber and relay components, featuring real-time, live and on-demand demo applications using the LOC and CMSF formats.

cards.title: Bitmovin Player Web X
cards.desc: Bitmovin's Player Web X playing live MOQ streams from several public relays, with a source picker, selectable target latency and rendition switching. Runs against draft-14, draft-16 and draft-18 relays; transport and packaging via moq-playa.

cards.title: Cisco MoQT client
cards.desc: Web based demo of Cisco MoQT application running on Multi CDN OpenMoQ relay network

cards.title: EZDRM C2PA Demo
cards.desc: Demonstration of C2PA metadata support in MOQ protocol, showcasing secure content provenance and integrity verification for media assets delivered over OpenMoQ relays. (user/pass: coffee/coffee)

cards.title: Vindral Composer
cards.desc: Vindral Composer in the Akamai cloud: the production and delivery chain deployed on Akamai infrastructure, with MoQ from Vindral Composer through to delivery.

cards.title: nanocosmos - MOQ Instant Test
cards.desc: Try MOQ right in your browser. No sign-up required. nanocosmos was one of the first platforms to run MOQ at production scale for real-time streaming, and this Instant Test lets you experience it yourself.

cards.title: Meta Player
cards.desc: This project provides a minimal implementation of media player based on MOQT draft-14, media transport is based on draft-cenzano-moq-media-interop.

cards.title: MOQtail Demos
cards.desc: Link to current MOQtail demos including ABR, AI timeline generations and watch party features.

cards.title: Eyevinn Player
cards.desc: A browser-based Media Player for MOQ protocol with WARP support. Supports draft-18, full WARP catalog support and multi DRM integration.

cards.title: Shaka Player
cards.desc: Shaka player demo showcasing links to multiple MOQ test streams with different formats and features including DRM, 4K and HDR content.

cards.title: OpenMOQ Test Suite
cards.desc: OpenMOQ test tools for protocol compliance, performance benchmarking, and interoperability testing of MOQ implementations.

cards.title: Protocol Benchmark
cards.desc: Compare live ingest protocols, network paths, and software components to find your ideal live workflow.

cards.title: Catalog Viewer
cards.desc: View and explore the catalog of available media assets, including metadata and preview options.
